summary: PPL Corp filed an 8-K reporting the Rhode Island Public Utilities Commission's (RIPUC) decision in subsidiary Rhode Island Energy's (RIE) base distribution rate case. RIPUC authorized $44.1M electric and $93.7M gas annual revenue increases, a 9.275% ROE, and 48/52 debt/equity ratio. It denied RIE's hold harmless proposal but approved an alternative increasing bill credits by ~$11M to ~$170M, effective October 2026-September 2027. PPL reaffirmed 2026 earnings guidance. Regulatory outcome; watch for final written order and possible appeals.
